features: 【Next-Gen AI Performance】 Powered by the Intel Core Ultra 5 125H processor with 12 cores, 22 threads, and 4.5GHz max frequency, for ASUS NUC 14 Pro delivers over 20% performance improvement. Featuring AI Ready, AI Boost, and AI GC, this mini PC supports low-power AI acceleration, enabling local AI tasks like graphics enhancement and video conferencing with 40% reduced power consumption.

【Unmatched Gaming & Editing】 Equipped with Intel Arc graphics, the NUC 14 Pro boosts gaming and video editing performance by over 2.5x. Its 32GB DDR5-5600MT/s RAM (expandable to 96GB) and 512GB PCIe Gen4 SSD ensure seamless multitasking and lightning-fast storage for demanding applications.

【Revolutionary Cooling System】 Unleashing Full CPU Potential, Featuring an innovative cooling module, this system utilizes an expanded fan area, advanced aluminum fin heat dissipation, and dual copper tube direct contact technology. This design maximizes CPU performance, while a dust-proof self-cleaning system extends hardware longevity. Even under heavy workloads, enhanced air circulation ensures quiet, efficient 24/7 operation.

【Immersive 8K Visuals】 Support for one 8K or four 4K displays with HDR delivers stunning, lifelike visuals. Perfect for multitasking, gaming, or creative work, the NUC 14 Pro transforms your workspace into a productivity and entertainment hub.

【Rich Connectivity Options】 Packed with 2x Thunderbolt 4, 2x HDMI 2.1, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, and a 2500MB Gigabit Ethernet port, this mini PC offers flexible connectivity for all your devices. The VESA mountable design saves space, keeping your setup clean and organized.

【Expandable Storage & Versatility】 Intel NUC 14 Pro,for ASUS NUC 14 Pro NUC14RVH Revel Canyon AI Mini PC supports additional M.2 2240 PCIe Gen4 SSD and 2.5-inch SATA HDD installations, providing ample storage options for gamers, creators, and professionals.
